bigFive.subtitleSelf: Each axis shows how you compare to other people — the further from the center, the higher you scored.
bigFive.subtitleOwner: Each axis shows how {{name}} compares to other people — the further from the center, the higher the score.

schwartz.subtitleSelf: Where each value sits relative to your personal average — bars to the right of center matter more to you, bars to the left matter less.
schwartz.subtitleOwner: Where each value sits relative to {{name}}'s personal average — bars to the right of center matter more, bars to the left matter less.

cope.subtitleSelf: The coping strategies you lean on under stress, strongest first. Higher bars are the responses you reach for most.
cope.subtitleOwner: The coping strategies {{name}} leans on under stress, strongest first. Higher bars are the responses reached for most.
cope.heading: Coping strategies

pid.subtitleSelf: Maladaptive personality traits from the PID-5 — higher bars indicate stronger expression. Your most pronounced traits appear first.
pid.subtitleOwner: Maladaptive personality traits from the PID-5 — higher bars indicate stronger expression. The most pronounced traits appear first.

ecr.explainAnxiety: Higher anxiety scores indicate greater fear of rejection and abandonment, while lower scores reflect a sense of security in relationships.
ecr.explainAvoidance: Higher avoidance scores indicate a preference for emotional distance and self-reliance, while lower scores reflect ease with intimacy and interdependence.
